665:t_008:21.en:
$$トライア$$
「...So what shall we do, Captain $$ジェフリー$$?」

665:t_008:22.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「First, let's return to the $$フロンティア船団$$ and assess the surrounding situation. We'll head for the galaxy's center after that.」

665:t_008:25.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The $$フロンティア船団$$ is about to enter a Fold!」

665:t_009:1.en:
$$カイエン$$
「What's going on?! Has someone seized control of the fleet?!」

665:t_009:2.en:
$$三島$$
「That is not the case, members of $c.」

665:t_009:4.en:
$$三島$$
「We will go our separate way. You might even call this a break with Earth's humanity.」

665:t_009:6.en:
$$赤木$$
「How can you say that in this situation?!」

665:t_009:7.en:
$$葵$$
「You're running away from the final battle with $$バアル$$?!」

665:t_009:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But if you act alone here, you'll only come under attack from the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$ギャラクシー船団$$!」

665:t_009:10.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The $$フロンティア船団$$ has already...!」

665:t_009:11.en:
$$三島$$
「That is correct. We have already formed an alliance with the $$ギャラクシー船団$$.」

665:t_009:12.en:
$$三島$$
「In other words, we have acquired the $$バジュラ$$'s power.」

665:t_009:13.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「With this power, we have nothing to fear from the $$宇宙怪獣$$. We could even transfer to a parallel world if need be.」

665:t_009:16.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Aide $$三島$$. Has President $$ハワード・グラス$$ approved this as well?」

665:t_009:17.en:
$$三島$$
「A new order has already been established within the fleet. Our old offices and organizational structure no longer have any meaning.」

665:t_009:18.en:
$$三島$$
「Thus, it will be useless for you to expose my past conduct.」

665:t_009:19.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Damn it! That man... $$グレイス・オコナー$$ has played him, and he's become obsessed with his ambitions again!」

665:t_009:20.en:
$$三島$$
「Before we depart for our new world, I thought I might repay you for all your interference, but...」

665:t_009:22.en:
$$ボビー$$
「You're just a sore loser! You hid and watched while we fought the Empire and the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$!」

665:t_009:23.en:
$$三島$$
「I would prefer you call it biding my time. ...But now, the sleeping lion has awakened.」

665:t_009:24.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「The Fold preparations will be complete soon.」

665:t_009:25.en:
$$三島$$
「Then let us depart for our new world... the $$フロンティア$$ protected by the $$バジュラ$$ Queen.」

665:t_009:27.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「That's right, $$ブレラ・スターン$$. That planet is the $$バジュラ$$ homeworld.」

665:t_010:0.en:
$$三島$$
「Even we did not expect to Fold out so close to the $$バジュラ$$ homeworld. Thanks to that, we have moved our plans ahead of schedule.」

665:t_010:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「No! If we attack during their Fold preparations, we'll endanger the fleet!」

665:t_010:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「Damn it! $$シェリル$$ is over there!」

665:t_010:4.en:
???
「So even the Wingless cry out when they are torn apart from those they love.」

665:t_011:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Now you understand a little of my pain.」

665:t_011:2.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You bastard! You followed us all the way here?!」

665:t_011:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You are such conceited Wingless. You no longer concern me at all.」

665:t_011:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But since you're here, let's play a little before I fight them.」

665:t_012:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... I invite you into the labyrinth of love and hatred.」

665:t_013:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Ha ha ha ha ha! Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!」

665:t_014:2.en:
$$モニカ$$
「I can't locate the $$フロンティア船団$$ or the new Buster Machine No. 3!」

665:t_014:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The distortion levels in the surrounding dimensional boundary are as stable as normal space!」

665:t_014:4.en:
$$トライア$$
「This is bad! Without any cracks, we can't break through the walls of space-time!」

665:t_014:6.en:
$$レド$$
「Are we trapped in this space...?!」

665:t_015:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
(You are being controlled by the $$ギャラクシー船団$$, just as I once was...)

665:t_015:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
(That is why I swear...! I will thwart their ambitions and free you, without fail...!)

665:t_016:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have confirmed an improvement in this unit's combat capability.」

665:t_016:1.en:
$$レド$$
「Does that mean I'm getting stronger?」

665:t_016:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「A $$マシンキャリバー$$'s combat capability is determined by the interaction between pilot and interface.」

665:t_016:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I judge that to be a more accurate expression.」

665:t_016:5.en:
$$レド$$
「We won't fall behind $$ストライカー#pilot$$ anymore.」

665:t_016:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I estimate that every $$ストライカー#robot$$ deployed on this battlefield is a slave of $$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#pilot$$.」

665:t_016:7.en:
$$レド$$
「To stop them, we have to take down the original $$ストライカー#pilot$$.」

665:t_016:8.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$... As former Alliance soldiers, that is our duty.」

665:t_016:9.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I understand. I will set that instruction as my highest priority.」

665:t_100:0.en:
$$アルト$$
(It must be so frustrating for you... to be controlled by someone and forced to do things against your will...)

665:t_100:1.en:
$$アルト$$
(Hang in there...! I'll free you from those $$ギャラクシー船団$$ bastards, I promise!)

665:t_101:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
(The $$ギャラクシー船団$$ has acquired the $$バジュラ$$'s power...)

665:t_101:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
(What are they after...? What are they plotting here...?)

665:t_102:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I judge the target's combat capability to be equivalent to the $$ストライカー#robot$$ type we fought on Earth.」

665:t_102:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Furthermore, their interfaces belong to the same series, leaving no gaps in their tactical coordination.」

665:t_102:2.en:
$$レド$$
「$$マシンキャリバー$$ combat was designed around coordination between multiple units from the start.」

665:t_102:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「However, this unit employs tactics that depart from that principle.」
